prompt: Call an IntSupplier up to maxCalls times and return the first positive value it produces, or -1 if none appears. Complete callUntilPositive in Retryable; the tests count calls with a counter-backed lambda.
explanation: IntSupplier is the primitive specialization of Supplier: getAsInt() returns an int with no boxing. The retry loop calls the supplier at most maxCalls times and returns immediately on the first positive result, so extra calls never happen -- the tests verify this with a lambda that increments a captured int[] counter. A captured local must be effectively final, which is why the counter is an int[] cell rather than a plain int.
hints: Loop from 0 to maxCalls (exclusive); each iteration makes exactly one source.getAsInt() call.
Store the value in a local variable and return it right away when it is > 0.
Reaching the end of the loop means nothing positive appeared: return -1 there (this also covers maxCalls == 0).
